metadata.description: Skills distilled from 29 books across four languages — English craft manuals, Chinese prosody and songwriting, Cantonese practice, Korean phonology — plus Sondheim's collected lyrics with his own commentary, covering song lyric writing from the intent gate to a spec sheet a generation backend can take

plugins.name: lyric-writing
plugins.description: 18 skills in six layers, with the language layer as the trunk: workflow and the LYR-SPEC contract; general craft (intent gate, structure, imagery, rhyme, narrative); four language layers that are genuinely different methods rather than different tables (Mandarin tone and the thirteen rhyme classes, Cantonese where the writing order reverses, English stress-to-beat, Japanese mora and 符割り); tradition layers (Chinese-style, musical theatre, rap); execution (tone-melody check, backend compile, AI-tell audit); and a case layer. Bidirectionally coupled to the arrangement library. Plain text, no tooling required; answers in the language you ask in
